title: Six bounded search charts for a two-coordinate field code

claims.statement: For the explicit code (a,b) -> (a,b,ab,a^3+3b^3) in the degree-500 binary field specified in proof.md, decoded by the six radius-108 pair charts with a,b nonzero and numerical ties, the average block error for uniform 1000-bit messages over 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 27654689647274881/500000000000000000.

The bsc-ops-v1 program for the same code and six-chart decoder uses at most the integer W=1415288*(sum of binom(1000,i) for i=0 through 108)+600 operations for every received word, with W<=2^(509851/1000).

experiments.purpose: Verify the degree-500 field and noncube witness, exact four-group coverage bound and memory and exponent comparisons, and exercise the linear solver and all six field charts.
